endpoints.prdJustification: F009 Users sign up using email；Q-030 裁决为无密码验证码登录
Core Flow 1 User signs up or logs in with email
Core Flow 5 起的每一步都需要已登录用户
endpoints.responseSchema: { userId: string; email: string; status: "pending_consent" | "active"; birthYear: number }

endpoints.prdJustification: Q-017 会话 30 天滑动过期，需要主动结束会话
F009 For child users, the app asks for parent email, sends a code
EH005 Display resend code button；TRD §4.5.2 重发使旧码立即失效
US-008 the system sends a code that expires after 2 minutes
EH006 Parent declines consent → Account is deleted
Q-011 家长可撤回同意，走同意邮件里的长期签名链接（PAGE-011 /consent/revoke）
F005 User uploads a photo of a handwritten notation sheet
endpoints.requestSchema: { photo: File; idempotencyKey: string; playedAt?: string }

endpoints.prdJustification: F007 progress screen；TRD §4.1 每阶段向客户端上报进度（SSE）
endpoints.responseSchema: { stage: "uploading" | "prescanning" | "reconstructing" | "awaiting_confirmation" | "failed"; percent: number; readablePercent?: number; failure?: { code: "prescan_failed" | "not_a_scoresheet" | "abandoned" | "timeout"; message: string } }

endpoints.prdJustification: EH004 用户返回时需要知道这次扫描还在不在
endpoints.responseSchema: { jobId: string; status: "uploading" | "prescanning" | "reconstructing" | "awaiting_confirmation" | "done" | "failed"; gameId?: string; failure?: { code: "prescan_failed" | "not_a_scoresheet" | "abandoned" | "timeout"; message: string } }

endpoints.prdJustification: F006 the user sees uncertain moves and a list of candidate moves to choose from
endpoints.responseSchema: { items: { slotIndex: number; ply: number; side: "w" | "b"; candidates: { san: string; confidence: number }[]; repair?: "inserted" | "deleted" }[] }

endpoints.prdJustification: US-003 I can quickly fix the game before analysis starts
PAGE-003 Dashboard 已分析对局列表
endpoints.responseSchema: { items: { id: string; playedAt: string; opponentName?: string; accuracy?: number; reportStatus: "complete" | "partial" | "none" }[]; nextCursor: string | null }

endpoints.prdJustification: PAGE-007 分析报告需要对局本体（PGN）
endpoints.responseSchema: { id: string; pgn: string; playedAt: string; source: "photo" | "manual" }

endpoints.prdJustification: US-004 Given I have confirmed the reconstructed game, When the analysis starts
F002 first explanation should appear within about 5 seconds, with loading state if full analysis is still processing
endpoints.responseSchema: { kind: "move" | "summary" | "done" | "failed"; ply?: number; classification?: "brilliant" | "great" | "best" | "excellent" | "good" | "inaccuracy" | "mistake" | "miss" | "blunder"; evalCp?: number; explanation?: string; failure?: { code: "engine_crash" | "timeout"; message: string } }

endpoints.prdJustification: F003 aggregates key turning points, recurring themes, and overall accuracy；EH003 局部报告
endpoints.responseSchema: { id: string; gameId: string; status: "complete" | "partial"; analysedThroughPly: number | null; engineVersion: string; depth: number; accuracy: number; summary: { strategicMistakes: string; whyLost: string; turningPoints: { ply: number; note: string }[]; recurringThemes: string[] }; moves: { ply: number; san: string; classification: "brilliant" | "great" | "best" | "excellent" | "good" | "inaccuracy" | "mistake" | "miss" | "blunder"; evalCp: number; explanation: string }[]; recommendations: { ply: number; conceptTag: string; title: string; url: string; source: "lichess" | "chesscom" | "youtube" | "chessable" }[] }

endpoints.prdJustification: Q-007 局部报告顶部横幅带一个「重试这局」按钮（EH003 自动重试一次之后的人工重试）
F008 User enters an opponent name, with rating and federation；Q-001 裁决评分为选填
endpoints.requestSchema: { name: string; rating?: number; federation?: "USCF" | "FIDE"; platformUsername?: string; usChessId?: string }
endpoints.responseSchema: { status: "resolved" | "ambiguous" | "no_information"; reportId?: string; candidates?: { source: "uschess" | "fide"; playerId: string; name: string; federation: string | null; currentRating: number | null; lastActive: string | null; sourceUrl: string }[] }

endpoints.prdJustification: US-007 I can review opening preferences, common patterns, and suggested preparation lines
endpoints.responseSchema: { id: string; opponentName: string; matchedProfile: { source: "uschess" | "fide"; playerId: string; currentRating: number | null; federation: string | null }; openingsAsWhite: { eco: string; name: string; games: number; score: number }[]; openingsAsBlack: { eco: string; name: string; games: number; score: number }[]; patterns: string[]; prepLines: { line: string; rationale: string }[]; sourcesQueried: { source: string; ok: boolean }[]; expiresAt: string }

endpoints.prdJustification: Metrics: the denominator is manually entered by the user through the prompt: How many games did you play in this tournament/weekend?
endpoints.requestSchema: { gamesPlayed: number; periodStart: string; periodEnd: string }

endpoints.prdJustification: Q-022 六个事件的最小集写进自建 metric_events 表，不接第三方分析工具
endpoints.requestSchema: { events: { name: "photo_uploaded" | "prescan_failed" | "moves_confirmed" | "analysis_completed" | "report_viewed" | "tournament_count_submitted"; gameId?: string; analysisId?: string; jobId?: string; reason?: string; occurredAt: string }[] }
